visual_overrides.core_identity: A predatory mimic disguised as a door, betrayed by a hidden eye, tongue-like handle, and organic warping in the door structure.
visual_overrides.silhouette: Mostly rectangular door silhouette fixed in its opening with restrained organic deformation.
visual_overrides.head_features: No separate head; one concealed eye and mouth or tongue integrate into hardware or panel seams.
visual_overrides.body_shape: Door slab and frame remain architectural while selected panels flex like living tissue.
visual_overrides.surface: Simple wood panels and iron fittings with sparse organic seams.
